method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Planning Act 1998 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/ (amendments to Act 23 of 2023, Act 25 of 2024 and Act 5 of 2025).

checks.command: l4 run pa-cases-development.l4 ; l4 run pa-cases-enforcement-appeals.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED to development control as it meets an owner or occupier. pa-development.l4: s 2 (dormitory accommodation), s 3 (development), s 4 (subdivision), s 12 (permission and penalties), s 12A (owner presumed to permit a tenant's development), s 20 (lapse) and the Fourth Schedule. pa-enforcement-appeals.l4: ss 21 and 22 (call-in, appeals, finality), ss 28 to 30 (enforcement notices), s 34 (civil penalty in lieu), s 42(3). Not encoded: Part 2, ss 12B to 19A, Part 3A, ss 25 to 27 and 31 to 33, the rest of Part 6, Part 7 and transitional provisions. No rules or s 3(2)(b) declarations retrieved.
